character: Highest Arc village at foot of Aiguille Rouge (3,226m). Best snow record, highest altitude. Base for best freeride and high-altitude terrain. Simpler facilities, bigger mountains. 5* hotel with Michelin-starred chef. Village Igloo ice bar. Vanoise Express to La Plagne. Red Rock Cafe.
dining: Le Savoy (wood-clad dining room). Les Chalets de l'Arc (chalet, fire, traditional French, chausson du Boulanger). Red Rock Cafe (burgers, pizza, apres). L'Ancolie (highly recommended). Village Igloo (ice grotto, fondue).
shopping: Less variety than lower villages. Small grocery, rental, basic shops. Easy to reach 1950 via free gondola.
apres_scene: Red Rock Cafe (lively apres, pizza, burgers). Whistler's Dream (young skiers/boarders). Latino Loco (food, atmosphere). Village Igloo (unique ice bar). KL92 (nightclub). L'Arpette (afternoon DJ above village).
activities_nearby: Aiguille Rouge summit (3,226m, 2,000m vertical descent to Villaroger). Vanoise Express to La Plagne. Igloo village (bar, restaurant, mini hotel). Cinema. Direct access to best freeride in Paradiski.
